verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance clearly documents renewal pricing for its registered agent service: $99 for the first year, renewing at $159 annually, with an option to lock in the rate by buying multiple years. Nothing in the evidence covers cancellation terms or how a client transfers out to another provider. The transition evidence describes switching into Harbor, not leaving it. missing for 10: documented cancellation terms, transfer-out/registered-agent resignation process, refund or proration policy on exit, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, renewal charges and cancellation or transfer-out terms are documented, so leaving the service does not strand the entity

citations.quote: $99 first year for new customers. Renews at $159 annually.
Purchase multiple years and lock in today's $99/year rate.
